lead.headline: Zvada kicked 2 — and Gordon still sits behind Marks
lead.deck: The kicker swap is losing; the FLEX swap is still not made. Loveland is gone for Odunze, both on bye.
lead.body: Dominic Zvada, added Thursday morning for Matt Gay, kicked two points against Washington; Gay plays Sunday. Ollie Gordon is still on the bench behind Woody Marks at FLEX — the projection prefers Gordon by 1.7, a coin flip it takes for free. Marks is healthy after a full Friday, but David Montgomery practised fully too and is questionable. This morning Colston Loveland went for Rome Odunze. Daniels and Likely have banked 48 against the unbeaten Maye-day.
